discordPostHtml:
Hey folks. It's been a while since this got updated - several game versions and a change of hands for Diable itself- but now that got to the rebalance and re-format to not use the original diableavionics_ prefix, it is finally ready to go. This also means there aren't patch notes, because it's been years.

Adds a pile of weapons and ships, including a neat frigate with a weapon swapper, a set of midline converts (including the Manta, made with permission!) and large versions of the meson family- the Shahana, a massive strike beam, and the Thales, a defensive four-beam sweeper! Please enjoy and yell if bug.
